newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO SEES 96 EARNINGS JUST UNDER 95.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO SEES 96 EARNINGS JUST UNDER 95.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat said on Tuesday it expected full-year 1996 earnings to fall slightly short of 1995, when it made a 141 million markka profit before extraordinary items.
"The financial result is expected to fall just slightly short of that for 1995," Raisio said in a statement with its January-August results.
Raisio said in June that it targeted profit matching the 1995 level.
Raisio said the transfer of margarine production for the Polish market to an enlarged plant in Poland was expected to improve profitability at its margarine division by lowering import duties.
Its milling subdivision expected improved profitability towards the end of the year, Raisio said, with fast growth in export sales continuing at least on the present level.
Animal feeds should improve their earnings, with exports of pet foods to Russia and Poland still growing.

"Business in the pulp and paper industries is expected to pick up towards the latter part of the year, justifying the prediction that demand for binders and special chemicals manufactured by the chemicals division will increase and that profitability will at least remain at the present level," it said.
It said a fall in January-August earnings to 91.5 million markka from 110.1 million a year ago was mainly due to the discrepancy between prices of mill products and animal feeds and raw materials.
"The situation has improved since late summer, however," it said.
On its new cholesterol-reducing margarine, Benecol, Raisio said exports "or other internationalisation" would not begin this year although preparations were underway and proceeding according to plan.
